epics.title: V1 enhancements
epics.acceptance: All thirteen V1 review findings are covered by implementation-ready stories and regression tests; release, coverage, document, synchronization, runtime, and traceability checks fail closed instead of accepting stale, malformed, incomplete, or unscoped state.

stories.title: validate.mjs enforces the full coverage contract's shape
stories.acceptance: Invalid coverage.mode, out-of-range coverage.min, blank coverage.command, non-string coverage.stacks entries, and malformed coverage.targets entries (missing fields, duplicate ids) all fail validate.mjs with a specific error, even when legacyContractGrace is active.

stories.title: coverage.mjs fails safely on malformed mode/min/threshold/--stack
stories.acceptance: An unknown coverage.mode, a non-numeric/out-of-range coverage.min, an invalid --threshold, or an unknown --stack all exit 2 with a clear message; only correctly-spelled off/warn bypass threshold enforcement.

stories.title: coverage.mjs supports explicit monorepo coverage.targets
stories.acceptance: Two workspace targets with different report sizes run and aggregate by weighted covered/measurable lines, not an unweighted average; a failing target command or missing declared report fails closed; target paths cannot escape the repository root; --stack can select exactly one target; single-root auto-detection is unchanged when coverage.targets is absent.

stories.title: CI workflow is seed-only, project-owned, and lockfile-rendered
stories.acceptance: The rendered .github/workflows/throughline.yml includes permissions: contents: read and contains no || true; a customized or pre-0.3.2 copy is never overwritten and never enters pendingReview but is reported as differing from the current render; a repo with no package.json at all defers seeding instead of baking in a workflow with no install step.

stories.title: release_in_flight required once epics declare explicit releases; no invented v1
stories.acceptance: An epic with an explicit release and no matching release_in_flight fails validate.mjs; build-dashboard.mjs selects an actual declared release and shows a visible configuration warning instead of a false 0/0 on-track dashboard.

stories.title: ensure-branch.mjs rejects --name=main and --name=master
stories.acceptance: Both names exit non-zero and leave the working tree exactly where it was, whether called from a feature branch, from main itself, or from detached HEAD.

stories.title: Bump plugin version to 0.3.2 across every manifest
stories.acceptance: package.json, .claude-plugin/plugin.json, .claude-plugin/marketplace.json (both version fields), .codex-plugin/plugin.json, and README.md all read 0.3.2; npm run doctor passes.

stories.title: Make lifecycle gates subject-safe, optional-aware, and release-complete
stories.acceptance: Bare G6 and G7 checks exit non-zero with an actionable --subject error; gate next skips optional G1.5 when it is pending; and the release skill requires approved G1 through G5 plus subject-scoped G7 approval for every epic in the release before presenting G8.

stories.title: Enforce PRD reference membership and complete V1 release traceability
stories.acceptance: validate.mjs rejects epic or story prd_ref values that do not exist in the approved PRD, and rejects a release when any PRD requirement tagged for that release is absent from its backlog contract; every REQ-08 through REQ-16 requirement is referenced by E-2 and at least one E-2 story so V1 rollups cannot report completion while core capabilities are unevaluated.

stories.title: Fail coverage closed on unknown stacks and stale reports
stories.acceptance: Configured coverage.stacks entries that do not match detected stack identifiers exit 2 instead of producing a skipped pass, and each executed custom or explicit target must create or update its declared summary during the current run; a successful command that leaves only a pre-existing report fails the coverage run.

stories.title: Preserve project hooks and repair standalone feature state
stories.acceptance: sync-plugin.mjs --apply installs the Throughline pre-commit hook only when no live hook exists or the live hook is already Throughline-managed; an unrelated custom hook remains byte-for-byte unchanged and is reported for manual composition, while --repair-state detects, reports, moves, and conflict-protects feature-* working directories under every unsupported platform root just as it does epic-* and ship-* state.

stories.title: Reject empty, malformed, or placeholder planning documents
stories.acceptance: check-docs.mjs rejects a PRD with zero valid requirement rows or malformed REQ-like rows, and an explicit architecture-tier check rejects template placeholder content in the system, stack, data, API, infrastructure, and ADR documents and requires a substantive security threat model so draft scaffolds cannot satisfy G4 validation.

stories.title: Reopen GitHub-backed stories and invalidate dependent completion
stories.acceptance: When a linked GitHub issue state changes from CLOSED to OPEN, sync-status.mjs moves its story from done to in_progress and recomputes dependency state so any story, including a previously done dependent, cannot remain complete while a blocked_by prerequisite is open.

stories.title: Align the declared Node runtime with the bundled c8 toolchain
stories.acceptance: package.json and README declare a Node engine range compatible with c8 12 (^20.19.0 || ^22.12.0 || >=23), strict-engine installation rejects unsupported Node 18/19 before tool execution, and supported runtimes can install and run the test and coverage commands without engine conflicts.
